text: In July 2022 Uzbek security forces used unjustifiably lethal and other excessive force to disperse mainly peaceful protesters in Karakalpakstan, where at least 18 protesters died; the UN human rights chief called for a prompt, independent investigation into the deaths.
short: Karakalpakstan, July 2022: lethal force against mainly peaceful protesters; at least 18 dead.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: Uzbekistan - Police Abuses in Autonomous Region Protests
source.quote: Uzbek security forces unjustifiably used lethal force and other excessive responses to disperse mainly peaceful demonstrators on July 1 and 2, 2022 in Karakalpakstan
